subject: Sequenced handoff: implementation milestones for cost & performance tuning
messages:
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>
To: Kai Zhou <kai@orchidai.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 20 Nov 2026 09:10:00 -0800
Subject: Sequenced handoff: implementation milestones for cost & performance tuning

Hi Kai —

Thanks again for the demo earlier this week. To keep momentum, below is a sequenced handoff we propose for the implementation phase focused specifically on token economics and runtime tuning. Goal: land predictable latency & unit cost targets for your inference traffic before the pilot end date (target: 2027-01-15).

Phase A — Profiling (this week)
- We’ll ingest 72h of representative traffic (you can send a subset or synthetic samples).
- Deliverable: token distribution + seq-length heatmap, hot-path latencies, cache hit potential.

Phase B — Baseline configs & routing (week 1)
- Apply conservative batching (max batch 8), enabled prefix KV caching for chat flows, route 100% to the small-quant model for low-cost background tasks.
- Deliverable: baseline perf/cost report and suggested SLOs.

Phase C — Quant & batch tuning (weeks 2–3)
- Iterate quantization profiles (int8 / q4_0-like variants) on a dev subset.
- Tune batching thresholds by p50/p95 latency targets, enable adaptive batching for bursty endpoints.
- Deliverable: quant-profile CSV + recommended routing policies for production.

Phase D — Canary & rollback policies (week 4)
- Canary to 10% traffic with automatic fallback to higher-precision model on quality regressions.
- Deliverable: canary runbook, alert thresholds, and automatic fallback config.

Next steps I need from your side:
1) A 24–72h traffic dump or representative sample (anonymized)
2) Who on your infra/procurement team we should loop for PO/SLA signoff (procurement@orchidai.com if available)
3) Any regulatory constraints on model quantization or VPC routing

I attached a draft SLA and an initial quant-profile proposal to this email. Monica & Karthik — can you confirm internal owners for profiling and routing templates?

Thanks,
Rishi
Head of Customer Success — Redwood Inference
rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai

Attachments: orn-hosted-sla-draft.pdf (pdf, 45KB), quant-profile-proposal.csv (csv, 6KB)
From: Kai Zhou <kai@orchidai.com>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>
Cc: Nora Bryant <nora@orchidai.com>, procurement@orchidai.com
Date: Mon, 23 Nov 2026 10:02:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Sequenced handoff: implementation milestones for cost & performance tuning

Hi Rishi —

This looks great and very actionable — appreciate the phased approach. A few quick notes from our side:

- We can export a 48-72h slice of anonymized traffic by EOD Wednesday (will include chat session IDs, timestamps, token counts).
- Procurement: Nora (cc’d) will lead contracting/PO. We’ll need a copy of the final SLA and a short summary of any data residency implications.
- Compliance: we have a restriction on model weights leaving our VPC; quantization on your side is fine as long as we preserve hash-identifiers and sign off on the profile.

Question on routing: for user-facing chat we want p95 < 400ms. Is the plan to route those to a higher-precision model and send background summarization to the quantized variant?

Proposed call: Wed 2026-11-25 11:00–11:30 PT to align on the profiling export and canary cadence. Does that work for your team?

Best,
Kai
Head of Platform — OrchidAI
kai@orchidai.com

Rishi / team —

Quick technical notes from an initial pass:

1) Profile plan: please ask OrchidAI to include a mix of conversational and summarization sessions (we’ve seen cache-hit variance increase when async summarization calls are interleaved).
2) Quant strategy: I’ll prepare the CSV of candidate profiles (q4_0-equivalent + int8 aggressive). We should run the q4_0-like profile first on a dev model with a 1k-sample eval set for exact-match/F1 and a small human QA spot-check for hallucination risk.
3) Batching profile: default start at max_batch=8 with inter-token timeout 15ms, then run exponential backoff to max_batch=16 for background endpoints.

Blockers: none right now. I’ll upload the initial profile and a short README to the Drive folder by EOD Thu.

Monica Patel
